## About
Dent Doctor, operated by Dent Clinic, specializes in Paintless Dent Repair (PDR) for hail dents, minor dents and door dings. The dent is worked out without body putty, grinding or paint, so the factory finish stays on the car.
Because the original finish is preserved, the repair helps avoid "diminished value" when you sell, trade in or turn back a lease. Beyond dents, the shop handles spot painting, scratches and buffing, body parts replacement, detailing and interior work.
Customers rate Dent Doctor 4.9 on Google from 575 reviews. Stop by 4524 Kenny Rd for an estimate.

## Services
- Paintless Hail Damage repair: Hail dents worked out without paint, keeping the original finish.
- Paintless regular dents repair: Door dings, creases, shallow and sharp dents removed without paint.
- Dent repair with spot painting: For dents where the paint needs attention as well.
- Scratches, buffing, and touchup: Scratch repair, buffing and paint touchup.
- Autobody parts replacement: Replacement of damaged body parts when repair isn't the right call.
- Premier high quality Detailing: Detailing to finish off your car's appearance.
- Leather Upholstery repair: Repair for leather seats and upholstery.
- Heated seats installation: Heated seats added to your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Is the estimate free?
A: Yes. Come by and in less than five minutes you'll know what it costs to fix the dent.

Q: Can I wait for the repair?
A: Often, yes. Repairs can often be completed while you wait.

Q: How does the cost compare to a body shop?
A: The site says paintless repair costs no more than 15-20% of the conventional repair, with no body putty, grinding or paint.

Q: What if my dent is too deep to come out completely?
A: They'll tell you up front. One reviewer said the shop explained their dent was too deep to disappear completely, set realistic expectations, and the result exceeded them.
